_doc: World hierarchy (source px). Regions partition the map for organisation/streaming; they are not visible borders. Settlements are points of identity.

regions.name: Laurel City
regions.desc: Larger west city on the Laurel River: downtown towers, rail yard, SR 400 / SR 9 freeways.

regions.name: Laurel Gap corridor
regions.desc: Rural transition along US 19 between Laurel City and Hollow Ridge: farms, Bald Ridge, Laurel Gap.

regions.name: Hollow Ridge
regions.desc: Old Appalachian town grown along US 19 (Main St), Falls Creek, and the Georgia Northern depot.

regions.name: North highlands (Stony Knob)
regions.desc: Central Appalachian high country: Falls Creek gorge, Stony Knob massif.

regions.name: South Fork highlands
regions.desc: South Fork gorge, Hollow Creek, Dockery farm, forested ridges.

regions.name: Tanner Valley corridor
regions.desc: Rural transition between Hollow Ridge and Tannersville: Harmony Grove, Tanner Pike, the Tanner meanders.

regions.name: Tannersville
regions.desc: Larger east city at the Tanner / North Branch confluence: downtown, arena, rail yard, SR 60 / US 76.
